name: pi-web
description: Web UI for the pi coding agent
readmeExcerpt:
# Pi Web

[中文文档](./docs/README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](./docs/README.ja.md) | [Русский](./docs/README.ru.md)

Local browser UI for the [pi coding agent](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi). Pi Web uses the same local configuration and session files as pi, so you can browse and resume conversations, run agent turns, configure models and resources, and inspect project files from a browser.

**[Try the interactive demo →](https://agegr.github.io/pi-web/)** The real Pi Web UI runs entirely in your browser, with sample sessions, files and models. There is nothing to install; replies are pre-written and no model is called.



## Features

- **Session workspace**: browse, resume, rename, export, and delete conversations grouped by project, with running state, context usage, cost, and compaction details.
- **Two ways to branch**: **New session** creates an independent session file from an earlier message; **Edit from here** creates a branch inside the current session.
- **Project file tools**: browse and upload files, inspect Git diffs, and preview source, Markdown, images, audio, PDFs, and DOCX files with automatic refresh.
- **Git worktrees**: switch checkouts from the sidebar while keeping sessions from the same repository grouped together.
- **Web-based configuration**: manage provider login and API keys, models, model tests, plugin packages, and skills without leaving Pi Web.
- **English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese UI**: Pi Web follows the browser language initially and provides a language switcher in the top bar.

## Quick Start

Pi Web requires Node.js 22.19.0 or newer. Check your version with `node --version`, then run:

```bash
npx @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

The CLI opens a browser after the server is ready. If it does not, open [http://127.0.0.1:30141](http://127.0.0.1:30141). Pi Web listens only on `127.0.0.1` by default.

If no model provider is configured yet, open the **Models** panel to sign in or add an API key.

To install the `pi-web` command globally:

```bash
npm install -g @agegr/pi-web@latest
pi-web
```

Commands:

```bash
pi-web version          # print the installed version
pi-web status           # list running servers
pi-web stop [--port N]  # stop a running server
pi-web open [--port N]  # open a running server in the browser
pi-web update [--check] # update a global npm install
```

To update, run `pi-web stop`, then `pi-web update` (or run the same install command again). To uninstall, run `npm uninstall -g @agegr/pi-web`.

## Configuration

For port and hostname, command-line options override the corresponding environment variables. Either `--no-open` or `PI_WEB_NO_OPEN=1` disables automatic browser opening. Run `pi-web --help` (or `-h`) to print startup options and exit without starting the server. Unknown options exit with an error.

| Option or environment variable | Purpose | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--help`, `-h` | Print startup options and exit | — |
| `--port <port>`, `-p <port>`, or `PORT` | Server port | `30141` |
| `--hostname <host>`, `-H <host>`, or `PI_WEB_HOSTNAME` | Bind hostname | `127.0.0.1` |
| `--no-open` or `PI_WEB_NO_OPEN=1` | Do not open a browser automatically | Browser opens |
| `PI_WEB_APP_NAME` | PWA manifest `name` and `short_name`; surrounding whitespace is trimmed, empty values use the default | `Pi Web` |
| `PI_WEB_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK=1` | Disable Pi Web update checks | Unset |
| `PI_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | Additional exact proxy or custom hostnames, comma-separated | Unset |
| `PI_WEB_PASSWORD` | Enable browser password login; API clients may use Basic Auth with username `pi` | Authentication disabled |
| `PI_WEB_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` | Session idle timeout in milliseconds, up to `2147483647`; `0` disables idle shutdown; invalid or out-of-range values use the default | `600000` (10 min) |
| `PI_WEB_SHUTDOWN_DEADLINE_MS` | How long extensions get to handle `session_shutdown` before a closing session is disposed anyway, in milliseconds up to `2147483647`; `0`, invalid or out-of-range values use the default | `5000` (5 s) |

Set `PI_WEB_APP_NAME` before starting the server (for example, `PI_WEB_APP_NAME='Work Pi' pi-web`). After changing it, restart the server to serve the new manifest; no rebuild is required. Updates to the name of an already installed PWA are managed by the browser and are not guaranteed to appear immediately. This does not change the page title or icons.

For example:

```bash
pi-web --help
pi-web -p 8080 -H 0.0.0.0 --no-open
```

### Remote Access

Binding to a non-loopback address exposes an agent that can execute high-privilege actions. On a trusted LAN, require a long random password:

```bash
PI_WEB_PASSWORD='a-long-random-password' pi-web --hostname 0.0.0.0
```

Password authentication does not encrypt the connection. Do not expose Pi Web over plain HTTP to the internet; use HTTPS through a trusted reverse proxy or a trusted VPN. If a reverse proxy sends an external hostname, add that exact name to `PI_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS`. This allow-list does not change the address Pi Web binds to.

### HTTP Proxy

Server-side model and API requests honor the standard `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, and `NO_PROXY` environment variables.

On macOS or Linux:

```bash
HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 \
HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 \
NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1 \
npx @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

On Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
$env:HTTP_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:7890"
$env:HTTPS_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:7890"
$env:NO_PROXY = "localhost,127.0.0.1"
npx @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

## Notes

- **Agent data**: Pi Web reads pi data from `~/.pi/agent` by default, including session files under `sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<timestamp>_<uuid>.jsonl`. Set `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` to use another pi agent directory.
- **Filesystem access**: Pi Web must be able to read the agent data directory and the working directories recorded by its sessions. Run Pi Web in the same filesystem environment as pi when sharing existing sessions.
- **Shared configuration**: the Models panel uses pi's model, settings, and credential storage, so changes are visible to both interfaces.
- **File access boundary**: the file browser is limited to working directories selected in Pi Web and project or session roots it already knows about; it is not a general filesystem browser.
- **Git worktrees**: see [Worktrees in Pi Web](./docs/worktrees.md) for switcher visibility, worktree creation, and removal behavior.

### Downstream Session Context Menu

Electron wrappers and other downstream integrations can provide a session-row
context menu without patching `SessionSidebar`. Listen for the cancelable
`pi-web:session-row-contextmenu` browser event and call `preventDefault()`
synchronously when the integration will handle it:

```js
window.addEventListener("pi-web:session-row-contextmenu", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const { id, path, cwd, name, clientX, clientY, refresh } = event.detail;

  void openSessionMenu({ id, path, cwd, name, clientX, clientY }).then((changed) => {
    if (changed) refresh();
  });
});
```

The detail object contains `id`, `path`, `cwd`, optional `name`, pointer
coordinates, and a `refresh()` callback for actions that change the session
list. If no listener cancels the extension event, Pi Web opens its built-in
session menu (pin, rename, fork, mark read or unread, archive, open in new
tab, delete) at the pointer instead of the browser's native context menu.
The row's `⋯` button always opens the built-in menu and does not dispatch the
event. Sessions not yet saved to disk get no built-in menu, so the native one
still appears for them. This hook is browser-side and independent of Pi agent
extensions.

### Extension Session Liveness

Server-side Pi extensions with detached work can prevent automatic idle
session eviction through the versioned global registry:

```js
const liveness = globalThis[Symbol.for("@agegr/pi-web/session-liveness/v1")];
const release = liveness?.version === 1
  ? liveness.register({
      name: "my-extension",
      sessionId,
      sessionFile: sessionFile || undefined,
      isActive: () => detachedJobs.size > 0,
    })
  : () => {};
```

Register once per active extension session and call the returned idempotent
`release` function on session shutdown, replacement, or reload. `isActive`
must be synchronous, cheap, and scoped to the supplied exact session id or
file. Provider errors fail safe by preserving that session. This lease only
affects automatic idle eviction; explicit shutdown and Stop fallback cleanup
still take precedence.

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

The development server runs at [http://127.0.0.1:30141](http://127.0.0.1:30141). Run the common checks with:

```bash
npm test
node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit
npm run lint
```

Do not run `next build` or `npm run build` during normal development. It writes to `.next/` and can interfere with the development server; leave builds for release work.

Before starting on a feature, read [Contributing](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for what is in scope and the pull request checklist.

Contributor guides: [Internationalization](./docs/i18n.md) and [Release process](./docs/release.md).

## Repository Layout

```text
app/             Next.js UI and API routes
components/      React UI components
hooks/           Client state and interaction hooks
lib/             Session, agent, model, file, Git, and security logic
public/          Static assets and PWA files
bin/             npm CLI entrypoint and launch option parsing
docs/            Focused user and contributor guides
demo/            Static browser demo published to GitHub Pages (see demo/README.md)
```

See [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) for the architecture notes and detailed file map.

## License

aiSummary.oneLiner: A local web-based UI for the Pi coding agent, offering rich session browsing, project previews, and real-time chat.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Pi Web is a local web application that serves as an exceptionally rich graphical interface for the Pi CLI coding agent. It operates by continually reading local Pi session files and rendering them into a beautiful browser workspace, seamlessly transforming raw terminal output into highly readable Markdown. The interface enables developers to intuitively browse past sessions organized by project, interact via real-time chat, configure AI models, and actively manage agent skills. Crucially, it incorporates a comprehensive file explorer that previews project files natively within the browser, providing immense immediate context while the agent works. This completely eliminates the need to constantly switch back and forth between a terminal window and an IDE.
keyFeatures: Session browsing: Continuously reads local files to accurately visualize past interactions, structured tool calls, and context usage in a clean UI.
Contextual file viewing: Directly renders complex project files, including source code, PDFs, and images, right in the browser while chatting.
Real-time chat interface: Delivers a sophisticated browser-based chat window featuring deep Markdown and Mermaid support for interacting with the agent.
Model configuration: Empowers users to rapidly switch active models, manage sensitive API keys, and seamlessly adjust thinking levels from the web UI.
Git worktree support: Enables effortlessly switching Git worktrees directly from the sidebar so new sessions strictly follow the chosen code checkout.

useCases.title: Visual Agent Interaction
useCases.description: Developers who highly prefer a ChatGPT-like web interface over terminal commands for managing complex, multi-turn coding conversations with the Pi agent.

useCases.title: Session Debugging
useCases.description: Engineers carefully review past agent sessions to quickly understand exactly which tools were called and what precise data was returned in a structured format.

useCases.title: Rapid Model Switching
useCases.description: Users effortlessly toggle between entirely different LLMs via the web UI to accurately compare performance and execution cost on specific programming tasks.

useCases.title: Safe Exploration
useCases.description: Developers can strategically branch off an earlier message in a complex session to safely try completely different implementation directions without losing state.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Developers and active users of the Pi coding agent who desperately want a richer, highly visual, web-based workspace rather than interacting strictly through the CLI. Users should be familiar with TypeScript development environments.

releases.name: v0.12.2
releases.body:
## 中文

基于 `v0.12.1..v0.12.2` 的提交整理。

```bash
npm install -g @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

### 新增

- **更多主题，按色块挑选**：新增暖沙、丁香、暮紫、余烬、岩蓝、高对比浅色、高对比深色和 Zenburn。设置里每个主题都画成它自己颜色的色块，浅色和深色按色调上下对齐，一眼就能比较。高对比主题的文字在所有背景上都达到 WCAG AAA。(#1269)
- **终端可以单独切换深浅色**：终端标题栏的太阳/月亮按钮只切换终端本身，不影响应用主题；切换时 shell 和正在输出的内容不会中断，选择按浏览器记住。(#1268, #1270)
- **看到每轮回答花了多久**：一轮结束后，过程折叠行（没有过程时在回答下方）显示「耗时 45s」，刷新页面后也一样。(#1222，感谢 CiereMars)
- **缓存与费用提示**：打开设置 › 常规里的「显示缓存与费用提示」（即 pi 的 `showCacheMissNotices`）后，聊天里会像 pi 的 TUI 一样提示缓存未命中及重新计费的 token、缓存预热、压缩和分支摘要的费用，以及 Anthropic 丢弃思考块。折叠起来的过程行会汇总其中的缓存未命中。(#1265, #1267)
- **Agents 切换器显示每个代理的用量**：主代理和每个子代理都显示活跃时长、token 数和费用，标题处给出合计，子代理花了多少一目了然。子代理那一行旁边新增侧栏按钮，一键打开或关闭它的只读记录标签页。(972b02d, 4b529b4)
- **归档视图可以按项目折叠和批量处理**：每个项目可以折叠（Alt+点击折叠全部）；项目的 `⋯` 可以恢复或删除该项目的已归档会话；归档栏的 `⋯` 可以全部恢复（可撤销）、删除全部或删除 30 天前归档的会话，删除前会告诉你数量。项目菜单的「查看已归档」会直接跳到该项目。(49c9ca8)
- **在新标签页打开项目**：项目分组的 `⋯` 菜单新增「在新标签页打开」(T)，在新标签页开一个同目录的新对话，原标签页不受影响。(#1208，感谢 xcg)
- **把文件拖进文件树上传**：从系统文件管理器把文件拖到侧栏文件树里的某个文件夹上，就会上传到那个文件夹；拖到空白处则上传到项目根目录。(#1192，感谢 dingxiaobo)
- **在设置里改模型的上下文窗口**：设置 › 模型里，内置提供商的每个模型行多了一个上下文窗口输入框，留空即使用默认值。(#1221，感谢 22zyfeng-collab)
- **更多文件类型有语法高亮**：源码视图新增 PHP、Lua、Dart、Vue、INI、PowerShell、批处理、Protobuf、diff 等 30 多种扩展名的高

releases.name: v0.12.1
releases.body:
## 中文

基于 `v0.12.0..v0.12.1` 的提交整理。

```bash
npm install -g @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

### 修复

- **修复 pi 1.2.0 发布后安装 pi-web 无法启动**：0.12.0 只固定了 pi 的四个包，而 pi 内部依赖用的是 `^` 范围，所以 pi 1.2.0 发布后的新安装会把 `pi-coding-agent` 1.1.0 和 `pi-codemode` 1.2.0 装在一起，启动时报 `The requested module '@earendil-works/pi-codemode/declarations' does not provide an export named 'MCP_TYPESCRIPT_PREAMBLE'`。现在依赖树里的每个 pi 包（包括 `pi-codemode`、`pi-mcp`、`pi-telemetry`）都钉到精确版本，以后 pi 再发新版也不会混装。(35067b6)
- 设置 › MCP：对提供资源（resources）的服务器点「测试」不再出错，改为显示「提供资源。」，和 pi 的 `/mcp` 一致。(35067b6)
- 配置了提供资源的 MCP 服务器时，发送消息不再白等 10 秒。(35067b6)

### 改进

- pi 升级到 1.2.0，变化见 [pi v1.2.0 发布说明](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/releases/tag/v1.2.0)。(35067b6)

### 内部调整

- 新增测试：锁文件里的每个 pi 包都必须是精确版本的直接依赖。
- 发布 npm 包 `@agegr/pi-web@0.12.1`。

## English

Prepared from commits in `v0.12.0..v0.12.1`.

```bash
npm install -g @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

### Fixed

- **pi-web failed to start when installed after pi 1.2.0 was released.** 0.12.0 pinned only four of pi's packages, while pi's packages depend on each other with `^` ranges, so fresh installs paired `pi-coding-agent` 1.1.0 with `pi-codemode` 1.2.0 and the server failed with `The requested module '@ear

releases.name: v0.12.0
releases.body:
## 中文

基于 `v0.11.1..v0.12.0` 的提交整理。

```bash
npm install -g @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

### 新增

- **一键删除项目的全部会话**：项目分组的 ⋯ 菜单末尾新增「删除全部会话… · N」，先确认（默认聚焦「取消」，回车不会误删），再删除该项目的所有会话（含置顶和归档的），正在运行或等待输入的会保留。(#1182)
- **在新浏览器标签页打开会话**：侧边栏会话标题现在是真正的链接，中键或 Ctrl/Cmd 点击即在新标签页打开；会话菜单新增「在新标签页打开」(T)。普通点击仍在当前页切换。(#1167, #1169，感谢 xcg)
- **子代理可连接 MCP 服务器**：配置文件写 `mcp: on`（或在 Agents 面板打开「连接 MCP 服务器」）后，子代理按普通会话相同的信任规则连接 `mcp.json` 中的服务器；只读工具的子代理（Explore、Plan）只运行服务器标为只读的 MCP 工具。(#1053, #1187)
- **子代理模型支持 `:level` 后缀**：`provider/model:high` 同时指定模型和思考级别，与 pi 的 `--model` 一致；Agent 工具说明里列出每个配置文件的思考级别。(#1188, #1189)
- **终端在竖屏触屏上提供 Termux 风格的额外按键**：两行 ESC / - HOME ↑ END PGUP 与 TAB CTRL ALT ← ↓ → PGDN，点按时软键盘不收起；CTRL、ALT 为单次修饰，也作用于软键盘输入的下一个字符。(#1166，感谢 vill)
- 设置 › Skills 显示技能的完整说明。(#1158，感谢 tammelin)
- 超过 256 KB 的 HTML 文件也能完整预览。(#1155，感谢 Tiger)

### 修复

- 完成提示音：空闲时暂停音频上下文（Android Firefox 不再在两次提示音之间持有唤醒锁），运行期间保持运行，锁屏时结束的运行也会响；超过 3 秒才恢复的提示音直接丢弃，不在回来时迟到播放。(#1157, #1178, #1185)
- 打开指向已删除会话的链接，不再显示该项目上次打开的会话，而是新建会话页并提示「该会话已不存在」。(#1168, #1180)
- Windows 命令行：`status`、`open`、`update`、`stop` 在 Node 23–24.19 / 26.6 上不再以 0xC0000409（libuv 断言）退出。(#1174, #1179)
- 扩展在回答生成或压缩期间调用 `ctx.reload()` 会被拒绝并给出警告（与 pi 的 TUI 一致），不再让进行中的回合失

releases.name: v0.11.1
releases.body:
## 中文

基于 `v0.11.0..v0.11.1` 的提交整理。

```bash
npm install -g @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

### 新增

- **文件浏览器默认显示在会话列表下方**（桌面端）：可拖动、可折叠的「文件 · N」区域，带自己的文件搜索；设置 › 通用 › 侧边栏里可改回「独立标签」。手机仍使用标签。文件树按项目记住展开的目录。(3fe257f)
- **新建会话页面重排**：品牌（logo、版本、更新提示）单独靠左，项目和工作树选择移到输入框正上方一行。(e2fe4fb)
- **新命令行命令**：`pi-web version`、`update`、`status`、`stop`、`open`。(#1139, #1154)
- **子代理工作可在右侧面板标签中查看**（只读的对话记录）。(#1129，感谢 @斑泥狼)
- 子代理支持可选的 codemode。(#1097，感谢 Zllf)
- 安装为 PWA 后，应用名称可在运行时配置。(#1147, #1148，感谢 TossPig)
- 会话停在扩展对话框上时，侧边栏显示为「等待输入」。(#1145，感谢 Mango)
- 聊天里的自定义消息可以从标题处折叠。(#1133，感谢 Brynne Taylor)
- 附件按钮可以选择任意文件，不只是图片。(#1101, #1122)
- CSV / TSV 文件在文件查看器里显示为表格。(#1150)
- 压缩摘要默认折叠，与 pi 的 TUI 一致。(#1026, #1123)
- 小地图的轮次从会话第一轮开始编号。(#791, #1151)；小地图新增锁定开关，可关闭悬停预览。(#1128，感谢 Mitchell Kager)
- 模型：显示 Kimi For Coding 用量额度 (#848, #1113)；「获取模型」时保留能力元数据 (#856, #1112)。
- 支持 `obsidian://`、`vscode://`、`zoommtg://` 等常见桌面应用链接。(#1108, #1118)
- 项目分组的显示名称可以在分组菜单里重命名。(#1047, #1125)

### 修复

- 侧边栏：点击「显示更多」后选中最后一个会话，不再露出更旧的会话；折叠分组会丢弃它的「显示更多」窗口。(51dda7c, 0066d5f)
- 运行中写入的文件、以及在编辑器或终端里的改动，文件树现在会自动刷新（运行时与窗口获得焦点时）。(#1144, #1153)
- 新会话的第一条消息，即使切换到别的会话也会发出。(#1146, #1152)
- 自动发现外部写入的会话文件，不用手动刷新。(#1100，感谢 arkk)
- 回到工作区时恢复打开的文件标签。(#1107，感谢 Tiger)
-

releases.name: v0.11.0
releases.body:
## 中文

这一版有两件大事：**侧边栏重新设计**，以及**修复了一个严重的安全漏洞**。请所有用户尽快升级：

```bash
npm install -g @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

### ⚠️ 安全修复（请尽快升级）

- **0.11.0 之前的版本，密码保护可以被绕过。** 之前每个 npm 包里都带着同一组固定的内部密钥。任何人从公开的 npm 包里读到它，就能绕过 Pi Web 的密码登录和来源检查（Host / Origin）。如果你把 Pi Web 开放到局域网或公网，别人就能直接操作你的 Pi Web：执行命令、读写文件。即使只在本机使用，也建议升级。
  - 新版本每次启动都会生成新的随机密钥，包里的旧值不再有效。
  - 如果安装目录不可写，启动时会打印警告，请换一个可写的位置重新安装。
  - 感谢腾讯玄武实验室 XlabAI Team 报告这个问题。
- Windows 上，git diff 接口可以通过目录联接（junction）读到允许范围以外的文件，现已修复。(#1039)
- Next.js 升级到 16.3.8，包含上游的多项安全修复。

### 侧边栏重新设计

- **所有项目同时显示**：每个项目是一个可折叠的分组，不用再来回切换项目。分组折叠时也能看到运行中和未读会话的数量。
- **置顶和归档**：会话可以置顶，也可以归档（10 秒内可撤销），不用再靠删除来整理列表。可以一键归档某个项目里 7 天前的会话。已归档的会话收到新消息后会自动回到列表。
- **项目顺序不再乱跳**：有新消息时项目不再跳到最上面。拖动分组标题（手机上长按后拖动），或者用菜单里的「上移 / 下移」来调整顺序。置顶、归档和顺序在所有浏览器和设备之间同步。
- **在侧边栏分叉会话**：会话菜单里的「分叉」会把当前分支复制成一个新会话，名称是原标题加一个短后缀。会话运行中也能分叉。
- **「会话 | 文件」两个标签**：文件浏览器占满侧边栏高度。顶部是项目和工作树选择，以及常用按钮：终端、在文件管理器中打开、上传、刷新、显示被忽略的文件、改动视图。在文件标签下，搜索按钮用来搜索文件。
- **新建会话时直接选择项目和工作树**：新会话页面顶部可以切换项目和工作树，已经写好的草稿、图片、所选模型和推理等级都会一起带过去。
- 会话行改成单行，更紧凑；悬停或右键打开菜单（置顶、重命名、标为已读/未读、归档、删除）。手机上菜单从底部弹出。

### 新增

- 把文件拖进聊天框，就会上传到工作目录，并自动 @ 提及这些文件。(#1094)
- 设置里可以自定义界面字体、代码字体和字重。(#1074)
- 文件浏览器可以显示被 Git 忽略的文件，变暗显示并注明原因。(#1092)
- 扩展可以在状态栏放命令按钮，例

readmeHtml:
Pi Web

中文文档 | 日本語 | Русский

Local browser UI for the pi coding agent. Pi Web uses the same local configuration and session files as pi, so you can browse and resume conversations, run agent turns, configure models and resources, and inspect project files from a browser.

Try the interactive demo → The real Pi Web UI runs entirely in your browser, with sample sessions, files and models. There is nothing to install; replies are pre-written and no model is called.

Features

  • Session workspace: browse, resume, rename, export, and delete conversations grouped by project, with running state, context usage, cost, and compaction details.
  • Two ways to branch: New session creates an independent session file from an earlier message; Edit from here creates a branch inside the current session.
  • Project file tools: browse and upload files, inspect Git diffs, and preview source, Markdown, images, audio, PDFs, and DOCX files with automatic refresh.
  • Git worktrees: switch checkouts from the sidebar while keeping sessions from the same repository grouped together.
  • Web-based configuration: manage provider login and API keys, models, model tests, plugin packages, and skills without leaving Pi Web.
  • English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese UI: Pi Web follows the browser language initially and provides a language switcher in the top bar.

Quick Start

Pi Web requires Node.js 22.19.0 or newer. Check your version with node --version, then run:

npx @agegr/pi-web@latest

The CLI opens a browser after the server is ready. If it does not, open http://127.0.0.1:30141. Pi Web listens only on 127.0.0.1 by default.

If no model provider is configured yet, open the Models panel to sign in or add an API key.

To install the pi-web command globally:

npm install -g @agegr/pi-web@latest
pi-web

Commands:

pi-web version          # print the installed version
pi-web status           # list running servers
pi-web stop [--port N]  # stop a running server
pi-web open [--port N]  # open a running server in the browser
pi-web update [--check] # update a global npm install

To update, run pi-web stop, then pi-web update (or run the same install command again). To uninstall, run npm uninstall -g @agegr/pi-web.

Configuration

For port and hostname, command-line options override the corresponding environment variables. Either --no-open or PI_WEB_NO_OPEN=1 disables automatic browser opening. Run pi-web --help (or -h) to print startup options and exit without starting the server. Unknown options exit with an error.

Option or environment variable Purpose Default
--help, -h Print startup options and exit —
--port <port>, -p <port>, or PORT Server port 30141
--hostname <host>, -H <host>, or PI_WEB_HOSTNAME Bind hostname 127.0.0.1
--no-open or PI_WEB_NO_OPEN=1 Do not open a browser automatically Browser opens
PI_WEB_APP_NAME PWA manifest name and short_name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed, empty values use the default Pi Web
PI_WEB_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK=1 Disable Pi Web update checks Unset
PI_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS Additional exact proxy or custom hostnames, comma-separated Unset
PI_WEB_PASSWORD Enable browser password login; API clients may use Basic Auth with username pi Authentication disabled
PI_WEB_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS Session idle timeout in milliseconds, up to 2147483647; 0 disables idle shutdown; invalid or out-of-range values use the default 600000 (10 min)
PI_WEB_SHUTDOWN_DEADLINE_MS How long extensions get to handle session_shutdown before a closing session is disposed anyway, in milliseconds up to 2147483647; 0, invalid or out-of-range values use the default 5000 (5 s)

Set PI_WEB_APP_NAME before starting the server (for example, PI_WEB_APP_NAME='Work Pi' pi-web). After changing it, restart the server to serve the new manifest; no rebuild is required. Updates to the name of an already installed PWA are managed by the browser and are not guaranteed to appear immediately. This does not change the page title or icons.

For example:

pi-web --help
pi-web -p 8080 -H 0.0.0.0 --no-open

Remote Access

Binding to a non-loopback address exposes an agent that can execute high-privilege actions. On a trusted LAN, require a long random password:

PI_WEB_PASSWORD='a-long-random-password' pi-web --hostname 0.0.0.0

Password authentication does not encrypt the connection. Do not expose Pi Web over plain HTTP to the internet; use HTTPS through a trusted reverse proxy or a trusted VPN. If a reverse proxy sends an external hostname, add that exact name to PI_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS. This allow-list does not change the address Pi Web binds to.

HTTP Proxy

Server-side model and API requests honor the standard HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, and NO_PROXY environment variables.

On macOS or Linux:

HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 \
HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 \
NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1 \
npx @agegr/pi-web@latest

On Windows PowerShell:

$env:HTTP_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:7890"
$env:HTTPS_PROXY = "http://127.0.0.1:7890"
$env:NO_PROXY = "localhost,127.0.0.1"
npx @agegr/pi-web@latest

Notes

  • Agent data: Pi Web reads pi data from ~/.pi/agent by default, including session files under sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<timestamp>_<uuid>.jsonl. Set PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR to use another pi agent directory.
  • Filesystem access: Pi Web must be able to read the agent data directory and the working directories recorded by its sessions. Run Pi Web in the same filesystem environment as pi when sharing existing sessions.
  • Shared configuration: the Models panel uses pi's model, settings, and credential storage, so changes are visible to both interfaces.
  • File access boundary: the file browser is limited to working directories selected in Pi Web and project or session roots it already knows about; it is not a general filesystem browser.
  • Git worktrees: see Worktrees in Pi Web for switcher visibility, worktree creation, and removal behavior.

Downstream Session Context Menu

Electron wrappers and other downstream integrations can provide a session-row context menu without patching SessionSidebar. Listen for the cancelable pi-web:session-row-contextmenu browser event and call preventDefault() synchronously when the integration will handle it:

window.addEventListener("pi-web:session-row-contextmenu", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const { id, path, cwd, name, clientX, clientY, refresh } = event.detail;

  void openSessionMenu({ id, path, cwd, name, clientX, clientY }).then((changed) => {
    if (changed) refresh();
  });
});

The detail object contains id, path, cwd, optional name, pointer coordinates, and a refresh() callback for actions that change the session list. If no listener cancels the extension event, Pi Web opens its built-in session menu (pin, rename, fork, mark read or unread, archive, open in new tab, delete) at the pointer instead of the browser's native context menu. The row's ⋯ button always opens the built-in menu and does not dispatch the event. Sessions not yet saved to disk get no built-in menu, so the native one still appears for them. This hook is browser-side and independent of Pi agent extensions.

Extension Session Liveness

Server-side Pi extensions with detached work can prevent automatic idle session eviction through the versioned global registry:

const liveness = globalThis[Symbol.for("@agegr/pi-web/session-liveness/v1")];
const release = liveness?.version === 1
  ? liveness.register({
      name: "my-extension",
      sessionId,
      sessionFile: sessionFile || undefined,
      isActive: () => detachedJobs.size > 0,
    })
  : () => {};

Register once per active extension session and call the returned idempotent release function on session shutdown, replacement, or reload. isActive must be synchronous, cheap, and scoped to the supplied exact session id or file. Provider errors fail safe by preserving that session. This lease only affects automatic idle eviction; explicit shutdown and Stop fallback cleanup still take precedence.

Development

npm install
npm run dev

The development server runs at http://127.0.0.1:30141. Run the common checks with:

npm test
node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit
npm run lint

Do not run next build or npm run build during normal development. It writes to .next/ and can interfere with the development server; leave builds for release work.

Before starting on a feature, read Contributing for what is in scope and the pull request checklist.

Contributor guides: Internationalization and Release process.

Repository Layout

app/             Next.js UI and API routes
components/      React UI components
hooks/           Client state and interaction hooks
lib/             Session, agent, model, file, Git, and security logic
public/          Static assets and PWA files
bin/             npm CLI entrypoint and launch option parsing
docs/            Focused user and contributor guides
demo/            Static browser demo published to GitHub Pages (see demo/README.md)

See AGENTS.md for the architecture notes and detailed file map.

License

MIT
